claims.claim: Masked feature prediction uses an online encoder and predictor, an EMA target encoder, stop-gradient, and L1 loss. The target branch sees the complete clip before target-position selection.
claims.boundary: A learned representation target is not pixel reconstruction; mask position conditioning is not control-action conditioning.

claims.claim: VideoMix2M combines approximately 2 million HowTo100M, Kinetics, and Something-Something-v2 videos; specified validation overlaps are removed. Inputs are 16-frame clips.
Matched ViT-L, multi-block, 90K-step comparison: single-view frozen attentive-probe K400 is 73.7 (features) versus 68.6 (pixels), while K400 full fine-tuning is 85.6 versus 85.4.
claims.boundary: Probe is supervised; frozen refers to the backbone. Do not combine these single-view metrics with multi-view headline results.

claims.claim: Qualitative visualization trains an additional conditional diffusion decoder over frozen JEPA predictions.
claims.boundary: Does not make the base V-JEPA pretraining objective a video-generation objective.

claims.claim: V-JEPA 2 representation pretraining is separate from V-JEPA 2-AC post-training; the latter uses a frozen encoder and an action-conditioned causal predictor.
claims.boundary: V-JEPA 2 without AC does not directly evaluate candidate control-action consequences.

claims.claim: Representation pretraining includes over one million hours of video.
Under 62 hours of DROID video remain after filtering; end-effector position, orientation and gripper states accompany video. Actions are constructed from adjacent state changes.
claims.boundary: Unlabeled means no task, reward, or success labels; it does not mean only raw visual frames.

claims.claim: CEM optimizes actions against L1 distance to goal-image representation; only the first action is executed before replanning.

claims.location: Section 4.1 Robot deployment; Section 4.2; Tables 2-3; Appendix B.2
claims.claim: Franka desktop arms in two labs outside DROID, monocular RGB, image goals, ten trials per skill. Pick-and-place receives intermediate image goals; the implemented planning horizon is one.
claims.boundary: Zero-shot is transfer to the new lab without new lab training data, not the absence of action post-training, supplied subgoals, or controllers.

claims.claim: Authors manually tried camera positions; limitations include camera sensitivity, autoregressive error and planning-search growth at longer horizons, and reliance on visual goals.
Published best probe scores include SSv2 77.3 and EK100 39.7 R@5.
claims.boundary: These are supervised downstream probes, not zero-shot robot scores. EK100 action labels and robot control vectors have different meanings.

claims.claim: Recipe adds weighted context-token prediction, multi-level self-supervision, modality-specific image/video tokenizers, VisionMix163M data, and model scaling.
claims.boundary: Dense features are an empirical representation result, not demonstrated causal structure.

claims.claim: EK100 action mean-class R@5: V-JEPA 2 1B = 39.7; V-JEPA 2.1 1B = 38.4; V-JEPA 2.1 2B = 40.8.
claims.boundary: The best new score changes model size; do not claim the new recipe improves every task at fixed size.

claims.claim: Under horizon 1 / 800 samples / 10 iterations / 3 seconds, cup grasp goes from 60% to 70%; reach and pick-and-place remain 100% and 80%.
claims.boundary: +10 percentage points for grasp at matched planner settings; ten tasks per skill is a small experimental scope.

claims.claim: V-JEPA 2.1 with horizon 8 / 300 samples / 15 iterations / 14 seconds reaches 80% cup grasp.
claims.boundary: +20 percentage points versus the old row changes the planner and compute; caption and abstract omit that distinction.

claims.location: README: Code Structure; Models; V-JEPA 2.1 Pre-training
claims.claim: Official project separates representation pretraining and action-conditioned post-training modules, and provides multiple 2.1 encoder sizes.
claims.boundary: No module was executed. Checkpoint availability is not independent validation or proof of production safety.

analysis_not_paper_claims: IT migration discussion is an interpretation of architecture and evidence requirements, not a reported cloud-system result.
Attention causal masks and action-conditioning do not by themselves establish causal-effect identification.
Public root-cause labels do not substitute for action/outcome recovery trajectories.
Local/global representation checks, target-alignment checks, and cross-topology tests are suggested evaluation questions, not completed experiments.
remaining_limitations: No independent reproduction or checkpoint execution.
Live official README links are not pinned to a commit.
The optional I-JEPA predecessor was checked only at abstract/metadata level.
No claim of exhaustively reviewing JEPA literature through 2026.
